stand: Russia and Ukraine are trading escalating long-range strikes as a fifth winter approaches. Russia has hit Kyiv's bridges, railways and energy sites, and pledges further strikes after Ukraine's attacks on its oil refineries. Ukraine says it has disabled over half of Russia's refining capacity and struck Moscow region with 650 drones, killing two. Civilians are dying on both sides. Washington is pushing trilateral talks by end-October; Kyiv says yes, Moscow's answer is pending. Germany pledged fresh military aid; Russia is accused of trying to intimidate Kyiv's foreign embassies.

src.name: President Vladimir Putin, Valdai Club forum (via ABC News)

claims.text: Russia says rail strikes hit military-logistics infrastructure, not civilians; Ukrainian accounts describe repeated strikes near passenger trains.
claims.by: Says: Russia's Defence Ministry — denies targeting civilians, says attacks target military transport infrastructure.

claims.text: Russia's Defence Ministry confirmed striking Kyiv's Northern Bridge, calling it a military-logistics target; two people were injured.
claims.by: Says: Russia's Defence Ministry, via Telegram — confirms the strike and its military rationale. Says: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko — two injured.

claims.text: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will intensify strikes on Russian oil refineries in retaliation for Russia's air campaign against Kyiv, and that Russian civilians will not be targeted.
claims.by: Says: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, to Reuters.

claims.text: Ukraine's Defence Ministry claims strikes have disabled 51% of Russia's oil refining capacity; the figure is unverified.
claims.by: Says: Ukraine Defence Ministry. Not independently verified — Russia has released no figures.

claims.text: Putin acknowledged Ukrainian refinery strikes have cost Russia around 1% of GDP, saying Ukraine only partially achieved its aim of damaging the economy.
claims.by: Says: President Vladimir Putin, at the Valdai Club forum.

claims.text: Russian officials give fuller detail on the 650-drone Moscow-region attack: one killed in Radumlya, another in Barbybino, seven injured, 47 houses, four apartments and three cars damaged, and 185 drones destroyed or neutralised over the wider region.
claims.by: Says: Moscow Region Governor Andrei Vorobyov. No Ukrainian confirmation in sources reviewed.

claims.text: War blogger Yuri Podolyaka's claimed strike on the Volodarskaya oil facility concerns the largest such site in the Moscow region, linked to Transneft and Moscow's main refinery, supplying all three of the capital's airports; still no official confirmation.
claims.by: Says: war blogger Yuri Podolyaka. No official confirmation given.

claims.text: Estonia's Foreign Ministry says Russia is trying to intimidate foreign diplomats in Kyiv to undermine support for Ukraine; Estonia says its embassy is staying.
claims.by: Says: Estonian Foreign Ministry. No Russian response appears in sources reviewed.

claims.text: A Guardian investigation found sanctioned tankers carried South Korean fuel to Russia in July-August; an analyst says this undermines the sanctions regime, and Seoul did not address the shipments directly.
claims.by: Says: Guardian analysis / CREA analyst Isaac Levi. South Korea's foreign ministry did not address the shipments.

claims.text: India's external affairs minister says Delhi is becoming more actively involved in efforts to end the war, including on Black Sea shipping safety.
claims.by: Says: India's External Affairs Minister Jaishankar.

claims.text: Zelenskyy says the US has proposed trilateral peace talks at technical level by end of October; Ukraine responds positively and awaits Russia's answer.
claims.by: Says: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, citing a US proposal. Russia's response not yet given in sources reviewed.

claims.text: Russia's Defence Ministry says Geran attack drones struck several Ukrainian data centres (Parkovy, Ukrtelecom, Giga, Podolsky) that process data for government, commercial and military services.
claims.by: Says: Russia's Defence Ministry, via TASS.

claims.text: Ukraine's embassy in India accuses Russia of striking a factory owned by Indian investors, as Delhi shifts toward more active peacemaking.

timeline.text: Drone strike near an Odesa-Kirovohrad passenger train forces a trackside evacuation; the train itself was not damaged.
A relative lull in large Ukrainian drone strikes on the Moscow region begins.
Putin says Ukrainian refinery strikes have cost Russia about 1% of GDP.
Russian drone strikes Kyiv's Northern Bridge over the Dnipro, damaging the road surface and injuring two.
Russia's Defence Ministry confirms the Northern Bridge strike via Telegram, calling Zelenskyy responsible for the escalation.
German Chancellor Merz visits Kyiv, pledging €1bn in military aid.
Russian drone attack injures a 53-year-old man in Pryozerne, Kherson region; separate shelling injures a woman in Bilozerka.
Russia launches 205 drones overnight into Monday; Ukraine's air force says 172 are shot down or suppressed.
Russian guided aerial bomb attack kills at least three and wounds 39 in Kharkiv; a search for people under rubble is under way.
Russian drone attack sinks a Turkish-owned grain ship in Romania's Black Sea waters; two killed, 11 rescued.
German minister Karin Prien arrives in Kyiv, a day after Merz's visit, to highlight support for children and civil society.
Russia says it struck the port of Vylkove and fuel depots at Chornomorsk in Odesa region and a power plant in Kharkiv region; one dead, six injured in Kharkiv.
Estonia's embassy says it is staying in Kyiv despite Russian intimidation; Ukraine's foreign ministry had denied reports of Western embassies evacuating west.
Ukraine strikes Russia's Moscow region overnight with roughly 650 drones; Russian officials say two are killed and a warehouse set ablaze.
A separate Ukrainian drone attack hits a minibus in Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia, killing three, Moscow-installed officials say.
Casualties from the Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia's Dnipro bridge rise to five injured, including two Red Cross workers.
A Russian drone strike sparks a fire on the roof of an educational institution in Kyiv's Obolon district; no casualties, fire extinguished.
Russian forces strike infrastructure in Odesa region again overnight; no casualties, residential areas undamaged.
Dutch PM Rob Jetten pledges F-16 maintenance, spare parts and ammunition for Ukraine after talks with Zelenskyy on air defence.
Russia's Defence Ministry says its Geran drones struck Ukrainian data centres used by government, commercial and military services.
